name: Luck Blade

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Luck
powers.text: Reroll one of your attack rolls, ability checks or saving throws (used on a failure; once per dawn).

powers.name: Wish
powers.text: Spend a charge to cast Wish. The blade doesn't regain charges.

summary: +1 sword, +1 to saving throws while you carry it, a daily reroll, and 0-3 wishes.
text: Attack and damage rolls with this magic sword get a +1 bonus, and simply carrying it adds +1 to your saving throws. Luck: While it's on your person, you can reroll an ability check, attack roll or saving throw you're unhappy with, but you must keep the new result; this resets at the next dawn. Wish: The sword starts with 1d4 - 1 charges. Holding it, you can cast Wish from it by spending 1 charge, at most once before the next dawn; once the charges are gone, so is this property.
